svg.text: parameter: on, off, reset, status | disk, pxe, bios
each *.py file of the plugins folder,
for each node: BMC address (ip4, else name),
up to --parallel N at the same time
each thread runs, for its node:
one line per node: OK (green) / ERROR (red)
with details, like the power state
exit 0: all OK, 1: a node failed,
buffered per node, printed in one block
